items.title: Wall Street's flip from AI stocks to elsewhere accelerates, while oil prices keep easing
items.summary: Most of Wall Street is rising Tuesday, even as stocks of computer chipmakers continue to tumble worldwide.  Oil prices, meanwhile, are easing further from the two-month high they hit last week.
